nauru.title: Flag of the Republic of Nauru

colors.note: Represents the Pacific Ocean surrounding Nauru
Twelve-pointed star representing the twelve original tribes of Nauru

desc:
- Blue field crossed horizontally by a narrow yellow stripe, with a white twelve-pointed star in the lower hoist quadrant
- Adopted on 31 January 1968 at independence from Australian administration
trivia:
- The flag literally maps the country's geography: the yellow stripe is the Equator and the star's position shows Nauru's location just south of it
- The twelve points of the star represent the twelve original tribes of Nauru
- Nauru is the third-smallest country in the world by area, only 21 square kilometres
